lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 오늘 경제 뉴스 봤어요? 수출이 줄었대요.
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, did you see the economic news today? Exports dropped.
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, oneul gyeongje nyuseu bwasseoyo? Suchuri jureotdaeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 봤어요. 수출이 줄어서 경제가 걱정이에요.
lines.en: Yes, I saw it. Exports fell, so I'm worried about the economy.
lines.roman: Ne, bwasseoyo. Suchuri jureoseo gyeongjega geokjeongieyo.

lines.beaver_en: What about the won's value? Did it drop a lot?
lines.learner: 네, 화폐 가치가 계속 떨어지고 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, the currency keeps losing value.
lines.roman: Ne, hwapye gachiga gyesok tteoreojigo isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How about real estate? Housing prices are still high, right?
lines.learner: 네, 부동산 가격은 계속 오르기만 해요.
lines.en: Yes, real estate prices just keep rising.
lines.roman: Ne, budongsan gagyeogeun gyesok oreugiman haeyo.

lines.beaver: 큰일이네요. 그럼 우리 회사는 어떻게 해야 해요?
lines.beaver_en: That's serious. So what should our company do?
lines.beaver_roman: Keunirineyo. Geureom uri hoesaneun eotteoke haeya haeyo?
lines.learner: 새로운 수출 시장을 찾지 않으면 안 돼요.
lines.en: We must find new export markets.
lines.roman: Saeroun suchul sijangeul chatjji aneumyeon an dwaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Right. Shouldn't we cut costs too?
lines.learner: 네, 비용을 더 아껴 쓰지 않으면 안 돼요.
lines.en: Yes, we must cut back on spending more.
lines.roman: Ne, biyongeul deo akkyeo sseuji aneumyeon an dwaeyo.

lines.learner: 그럼요. 수출이 증가해야 경제가 발전할 수 있어요.
lines.en: Of course. Exports need to increase for the economy to develop.
lines.roman: Geureomyo. Suchuri jeunggahaeya gyeongjega baljeonhal ssu isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 이 문제를 팀장님과 의논해 볼까요?
lines.beaver_en: Then shall we discuss this with the team leader?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom i munjereul timjangnimgwa uinonhae bolkkayo?
lines.en: Yes, let's discuss it together this afternoon.

lines.beaver_en: We'd better prepare materials before that.
lines.en: I'll put together the related materials.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. What time is the meeting?
lines.en: It's at three. I'll book the meeting room.

lines.beaver_en: Great. I hope the economy gets better soon.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 우리도 노력하지 않으면 안 돼요.
lines.en: Right. We have to make an effort too.
lines.roman: Majayo. Urido noryeokaji aneumyeon an dwaeyo.
